prefix-budget-design.json.status: Read-only design of the smallest consumer admission/prefix change. No new library mechanism is required for whole prompt and lag0 partial>=2; proposed T1 policy change is described separately, not signed as implemented.
conclusions: Use one Model/shared families/current original episode helper. Keep unfinished resident Sessions protected and queue the rest. Never evict an unfinished MTP head and claim ordinary token replay can rebuild it.

Directory aliases are expendable even when their Snapshot is an unfinished Session head. Remove the cache entry, not the live Session state. Hit pins are temporary lookup protection, not generation-long state permissions.

At a retired boundary let L=actual VersionCount.live and D=0/1 for the selected R1 base that will really disappear after success. Require L<=N and L-D+1<=N before a graph. Candidate peak may be N+1; post-commit must return<=N.

Whole-hit adopts the original complete lag0 Snapshot, emits its stored next_id and executes0Graph. Partial reuse imports the same complete state with no tail write caps, uses ordinary existing MTP prefill math and original target/draft COW.
Only successful prompt lag0 boundaries enter this directory. No generated/lag1/multiturn checkpoint or generic MTP replay claim is included.
minimal_admission: Validate every prompt ID/context/output capacity before Model, including queued users. ResolveR=1. Choose effectiveN<=requested max_sessions and input count; explicit cache bytes may reduce N to the largest existing cache::plan(C,N,maxQ,payload,1,2,true) that fits. If even N1 cannot fit, reject before loading weights.

Use existing request indexes and a bounded resident_count/pending cursor. A request becomes resident only after a prior done request has successfully stop/try_retire/reset its Session. Unfinished Sessions stay resident between visits. No separate executor/cache manager is needed.

If the existing SessionCache is reused instead of a direct resident counter, keep its Pin across the entire unfinished request, or make retirement callback reject unfinished entries. Resetting a pin after every episode must not expose unfinished MTP state to LRU eviction. Pin count is admission protection, not simultaneous GPU width.

On admission, resolve a prefix hit before evicting checkpoints. A hit creates no distinct Snapshot/zero-state allocations. A miss needs initial room L+1<=N, made only by unpinned checkpoint eviction and re-reading L. Protect existing unfinished Session heads; if no legal room exists, keep the incoming request queued.

After each terminal episode save all host result/frontier stats. If done, perform original stop and actual try_retire before returning its resident slot. Native pending/error still keeps the same candidate, base and slot charged; queue admission cannot override the Model global loan.

Exact whole hits execute0 Graph; partial hits execute only the truthful T1 or multirow suffix. All miss/suffix shapes are cold-compiled from the finite validated prompt set.

Version pressure uses real L and D: fresh admission requires L+1<=N; an R1 advance requires L-D+1<=N, and D counts a selected base only when no directory or other Session retains it. Dropping a directory alias never deletes an unfinished Session. Hit temporaries are reset before this gate.

Only lag0 kMtpSingle input policy is relaxed for actual teacher-forced T1 prompt append. The actual host first_input is checked against the immutable original pending ID inside the original post-Completion selector when generation finish is requested. Graph mathematics, public APIs, native providers,14-bank transactions and retirement mechanisms are unchanged.

The permanent prefix probe actually executes15 Graph calls. Three whole-hit observations compare52 state components without fabricating logits/hidden; real commits compare54 vectors. All534 paired vectors are finite and byte-identical to the same-partition baselines, with7 complete old-prefix byte checks. The teacher-forced input248045 differs from pending198; wrong generation finish rejects after the native terminal, recycles14 bound banks, preserves the old head, and the same slot succeeds on truthful retry.

Archived previous-stage payloads are read through original SHA/entry mappings without extraction. Two later partial-request outputs are finite only; no independent same-partition oracle is retained for their later round.

Queued prefill/decode may alternate. Disjoint continuous episode intervals end at the original token-visible host endpoints and sum to one global wall; per-request waiting latencies are not summed. Final tail work is separate. Trace/probe timing is not a speed comparison.
